It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.


 Job Description
Summary:
Liberator Medical Supply, a BD company, is seeking a dynamic and strategic Lead Quality Assurance Engineer with a strong track record of leading and coordinating onshore and offshore QA teams, championing quality best practices, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions to our customers.
Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Software Quality Engineering, the Lead QA Engineer plays a critical role in driving quality across complex, cross-functional initiatives and ensuring the reliability of BD’s software solutions. This role is focused on leading and coordinating QA efforts across distributed onshore and offshore teams, as well as multiple vendor partners, to deliver high-quality outcomes.
In this crucial leadership role, in partnership with the Sr. Manager, Software Quality Engineering, you will help establish the best practices to test our products, proactively identifying and working with the team in resolving defects to ensure they meet our highest standards of performance, reliability, and usability. Your expertise will directly contribute to delivering a seamless and positive experience for our customers, supporting BD’s mission of providing innovative and dependable software solutions. This position requires a hands-on Lead QA Engineer who can effectively manage and support testing efforts end-to-end, while also contributing directly when needed. In addition, you will lead test strategies across initiatives, strengthen test coverage, and proactively identify and address risks and defects. You will coordinate across teams and vendors to support efficient, predictable delivery while introducing modern tools and AI-driven approaches to improve test efficiency and overall quality outcomes.
The Lead QA Engineer role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional with strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills. This individual will partner with Sr. Manager, Software Quality Engineering, Product Owners, development teams, and vendors to drive scalable QA strategies, ensure alignment with business priorities, and deliver high-quality solutions that meet customer and organizational needs. The ideal candidate will also demonstrate the ability to work independently with minimal guidance, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment. The candidate will demonstrate accountability for quality outcomes, with a strong focus on delivering reliable, scalable, and high-quality software solutions. Having strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis and drive improvements in product quality will be key.
Responsibilities:
Provide day-to-day guidance and mentorship to QA engineers and SDETs, supporting their technical growth and delivery effectiveness
Act as the primary QA point of contact for assigned projects, ensuring alignment across teams and stakeholders
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to ensure clear, testable requirements and shared quality expectations
Define and execute test strategies aligned with project scope, timelines, and delivery goals
Plan and estimate testing activities to ensure efficient execution and adequate coverage
Oversee execution of manual and automated testing across functional, regression, and integration areas
Review and validate test cases to ensure alignment with business and technical requirements
Drive adoption and implementation of test automation, improving efficiency and consistency
Maintain and enhance automation frameworks, tools, and scripts
Leverage AI-driven tools and modern testing techniques to optimize test design, accelerate automation development, imp [...] stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.
